reader_summary.overview: In this hallway conversation of the a16z Podcast. How much can you discern each company's "big picture" strategy out of the slew of new products, press releases, and announcements that flood the floor? How do you sort the wheat from the chaff?

key_points.text: In this hallway conversation of the a16z Podcast.
And beyond the event of CES itself, Evans and Sinofsky analyze the experimentation we're beginning to see in connected consumer electronics for the home.
When it comes to the smart home, it seems as though more is better -- more devices, more connectivity.
